post.description:
Go available (receive new visit offers) or unavailable (stop receiving them).

Accepted bookings and offers already sent are unaffected. Going available needs a location on
file (409 otherwise); the position must also stay fresh (see LOCATION_FRESHNESS_MINUTES) for
offers to arrive. Every location ping carries its own `is_available` (default true), so the app
must send the current value on each ping or a ping will switch the caregiver back on.

post.description: Offer a pending booking to one caregiver (they still accept), or force it (Super Admin).
Move an accepted visit that has not started to another approved caregiver.
Approve every payout still waiting in the batch. The send job then pays them through Paystack.
Cancel a batch that has not been approved: every payout in it is cancelled and its money returned.
Cancel a payout that has not been approved; the reserved money goes back to the caregiver's available balance.
Send a failed or reversed payout again (the money is reserved again; the send job pays it).

Settle a payout Paystack's own word has not (``processing``, for example stuck at OTP, or ``needs_attention``) as
``paid`` or ``failed`` (the reserved money is returned). Paystack is asked first; an answer that contradicts the outcome
refuses it, and an answer that is not final needs ``force: true``.

Let a caregiver whose payouts were frozen be paid again. Refused while any of their payouts still needs attention or is
processing. A shortfall is first debited from the caregiver's available balance; what the balance cannot cover refuses the
unfreeze (409) unless ``write_off_shortfall`` is true.

post.description: Raise a refund by hand (a complaint, or anything else). It waits for someone else to approve it.
Approve a pending refund. Above the Finance limit, or to the wallet, a Super Admin is needed.
Reject a pending refund; it is finished and the booking can be refunded again.
Send a failed refund again, once Paystack confirms the last attempt failed.
Give Paystack the family's bank account for a refund that needs it. The account number is never stored.
Pay a failed refund to the patient's Oakly wallet instead (Super Admin).
Give up on a failed refund: the money stays with Oakly and the booking can be refunded again.
Settle a refund in review as succeeded or failed after checking the Paystack dashboard (Super Admin).
